stories.text: 🔮 PROJECTION FLIP: 49er Faith-Fool is now projected to beat Mr. Action Jackson.

🎯 10 teams are in the thick of the median race, with Kyle Tucker right on the line (52%).

🥊 Waiver tug-of-war: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy beat Ruffing the Passer and The Mahomies to Will Shipley. Condolences to the rest.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: Ruffing the Passer added Brian Robinson Jr. (RB, projected 8.17 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 Stock rising: 49er Faith-Fool has its ESPN projection trending up.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
